metaDescription: Order custom SM caps in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams and events. Get your quote today.
introHtml: SM caps offer a classic baseball silhouette with a structured fit that holds its shape wear after wear. Made from cotton or polyester blends, these caps are ideal for embroidery or screen printing with your logo. Safety managers and HR directors often choose SM caps for uniform programs because of their consistent sizing and durable construction. They are a reliable choice for outdoor events, trade shows, or employee gifts.
